By September 2026 it had four OEM mass-production programs with expected lifetime sales above USD 300m. Together with existing large-scale WCBS delivery, this combination of safety certification, validation depth, embedded OEM programs and scaled manufacturing constitutes a verified replication barrier in brake-by-wire.

predictability.rationale: The audited 2025 annual report supplies three consecutive complete fiscal years (2023-2025) in one official table. Revenue and profit never breached the system's downside stability floors, cash-flow decline in 2025 was about 18% and remained well inside the -50% floor, and three-year profit/cash-flow volatility stayed far below the 5x ceiling. This meets the frozen strict multi-year accounting-predictability rule for a non-resource automotive-parts business.
